c74object.name: evi_crossover_allpass
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Allpass filter for aligning audio bands using evieve crossover filters
c74object.description:
evi_crossover_allpass is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_crossover_allpass.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_crossover_allpass is also available in MSP as: evi.crossover.allpass~.
Multiband Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters require alpass alignment. This filter gives access to the same filters used in all the evieve crossover filters, in case a custom summing method is wished for.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: to be Compensated. One band of audio input.

geninlet.name: allpass
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. This should be fed from the 'High Frequency Cutoff' of a multiband crossover filter split to achieve correct alignment.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0=1-pole allpass filter, 1=2-pole allpass filter. 1-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 2-pole crossover filter. 2-pole allpass filters are for aligning one band of a 4-pole crossover filter.
